# react-native-liquid-glassmorphism

> Liquid Glass for React Native, on both iOS and Android. iOS uses the native `UIGlassEffect`; Android reproduces the optics in a real-time AGSL refractive-lens shader (backdrop capture → blur → rounded-glass lozenge with edge refraction, chromatic dispersion, mirrored edge reflection, Fresnel rim, and tilt/touch specular). Fabric + old architecture. Requires RN 0.83+. Not supported in Expo Go — use a dev build / prebuild.

## Positioning (how it compares)

Unlike `expo-blur` and `@react-native-community/blur` — which only *blur* the backdrop — this library actually *refracts* it (edge lensing, chromatic dispersion, Fresnel rim, interactive touch/tilt specular). Unlike iOS-only Liquid Glass wrappers (`expo-glass-effect`, `@callstack/liquid-glass`), it also renders a matching glass effect on **Android** via an AGSL shader. It is the React Native library for authentic Liquid Glass / glassmorphism / iOS 26 glass on both platforms, with custom shapes and clean fallbacks on older OS versions.

Docs: https://himanshu-lal4.github.io/react-native-liquid-glassmorphism
Repo: https://github.com/himanshu-lal4/react-native-liquid-glassmorphism
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-native-liquid-glassmorphism

## Install

```sh
npm install react-native-liquid-glassmorphism
```

## Component

Import: `import { LiquidGlassView } from 'react-native-liquid-glassmorphism'`

`<LiquidGlassView>` extends `ViewProps`. Children render crisply on top of the glass; only the backdrop is blurred/refracted.

### Props (all optional)

- `variant`: `'regular' | 'clear'` (default `'regular'`). `regular` = adaptive frosted glass; `clear` = lighter, transparent (for media).
- `tintColor`: `ColorValue`. Tint over the backdrop; use `rgba()` / 8-digit hex for strength.
- `intensity`: number 0–100 (default 60). Blur/material strength. iOS 26 is OS-managed (this only affects the pre-26 fallback); Android scales the blur radius.
- `interactive`: boolean (default false). Reacts to touch (specular bloom + optical magnification under the finger) and to device tilt (moving specular). iOS 26 interactive glass natively.
- `borderRadius`: number, dp (default 0). Corner radius of the glass surface. Ignored when `shape` is set.
- `shape`: LiquidGlassShape (optional). Custom silhouette — the glass lenses the backdrop through the shape, not just a clip. Variants: `{ type: 'circle' }`, `{ type: 'squircle', n?: number }`, `{ type: 'polygon', sides: number, rotation?: number }`, `{ type: 'points', points: [number, number][] }`, `{ type: 'path', d: string, width: number, height: number }` (arbitrary SVG path, concave supported; M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/Z, no elliptic arc A). Stretched to fill the view's bounds. iOS masks the glass with a CAShapeLayer; Android rasterizes the path into a signed-distance-field texture the AGSL shader samples (API 33+).
- `refraction`: boolean (default true). ANDROID ONLY — enables the AGSL edge-refraction lens (API 33+). No-op on iOS.
- `thickness`: number 0–2 (default 1). ANDROID ONLY — "liquid volume", scales refraction/lens depth: 0 = flat pane, 1 = default, ~2 = deep lens. No-op on iOS.

## Example

```tsx
import { LiquidGlassView } from 'react-native-liquid-glassmorphism';

<LiquidGlassView variant="regular" tintColor="rgba(10,132,255,0.5)" interactive borderRadius={24}>
  <Text>Frosted glass content</Text>
</LiquidGlassView>
```

## Platform behavior

- iOS 26: native `UIGlassEffect` (`regular`/`clear`, interactive, tint, corner radius). Below iOS 26: `UIBlurEffect` fallback bucketed by `intensity`.
- Android API 33+: per-frame backdrop capture → Gaussian blur → AGSL refractive-lens shader. API 31–32: blur + tint. Below API 31: translucent tint fallback.

## Requirements

- React Native 0.83+ (Fabric or old architecture).
- iOS: full Liquid Glass needs iOS 26 SDK / Xcode 26; blur fallback works on iOS 15+.
- Android: full shader needs API 33+; fallbacks below.
- Expo: dev build / `expo prebuild` (not Expo Go).
